description: API documentation for the 3D tank combat template

GameConfig.description: Minimal configuration accessor that loads values from game_config.cfg. Available as global singleton.

signals.name: config_loaded
signals.description: Emitted when configuration file has been loaded

methods.name: get_value
methods.signature: get_value(section: String, key: String, default = null) -> Variant
methods.description: Get a value from the config file by section and key

properties.name: is_loaded
properties.description: True when config file has been loaded

Log.description: Static logging utility. Use directly via class name (NOT an autoload).
Log.note: This is a class_name, not an autoload. All methods are static - call directly on Log class.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Log an info message

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Log a warning message (yellow)

methods.name: error
methods.description: Log an error message to stderr

methods.name: performance
methods.description: Log a performance message (cyan)

methods.name: start_performance_check
methods.description: Start timing a named performance check

methods.name: end_performance_check
methods.description: End timing and log the duration

CameraRig.description: Camera management component with three modes: Chase, TopDown, Free. Owns mouse mode.

signals.name: camera_mode_changed
signals.description: Emitted when camera mode changes (C key or switch_mode call)

methods.name: switch_mode
methods.description: Activate a camera mode and set appropriate mouse mode

methods.name: get_active_camera
methods.description: Returns the currently active Camera3D

methods.name: get_current_mode
methods.description: Returns the current camera mode enum value

methods.name: set_chase_yaw
methods.description: Called by tank controller to sync chase camera with turret rotation

methods.name: apply_camera_kick
methods.description: Called by ShootingFeedback to add recoil kick to chase camera

ShootingComponent.description: Tank shooting system with barrel detection, CameraRig-aware aiming, and Timer-based cooldown.

signals.name: shot_fired
signals.description: Emitted when a projectile is fired

signals.name: ammo_changed
signals.description: Emitted when ammo count changes (fire or reload)

methods.name: get_muzzle_position
methods.description: Returns the barrel tip world position

methods.name: get_fire_direction
methods.description: Returns normalized direction from muzzle to aim target

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Manually trigger a reload

ShootingFeedback.description: Subscribes to ShootingComponent.shot_fired for camera kick, screen shake, muzzle flash, and barrel recoil. All config-driven.

AimingHelper.description: Static utility class for aim raycasts.

methods.name: get_screen_center_target
methods.signature: static func get_screen_center_target(camera: Camera3D, max_distance: float, exclude_bodies: Array = []) -> Vector3
methods.description: Raycast from screen center into the scene

methods.name: get_mouse_ground_target
methods.signature: static func get_mouse_ground_target(camera: Camera3D, mouse_position: Vector2, ground_y: float = 0.0, exclude_bodies: Array = []) -> Vector3
methods.description: Raycast from mouse position to ground plane

methods.name: calculate_fire_direction
methods.signature: static func calculate_fire_direction(muzzle_position: Vector3, target_position: Vector3) -> Vector3
methods.description: Calculate normalized direction from muzzle to target

methods.name: has_clear_line_of_sight
methods.signature: static func has_clear_line_of_sight(from_position: Vector3, to_position: Vector3, world_3d: World3D, exclude_bodies: Array = []) -> bool
methods.description: Check if there is a clear line of sight between two positions

TankProjectile.description: RigidBody3D projectile with configurable color, gravity, and hit effects.

methods.name: launch
methods.signature: func launch(launch_direction: Vector3, launch_speed: float = 30.0, launch_gravity_scale: float = 0.15) -> void
methods.description: Launch projectile in a direction with speed and gravity

warnings: Do NOT create a new class_name Log - it already exists in logger.gd
Do NOT add Log as an autoload - it uses static methods via class_name
Always use Log.info(), Log.error(), Log.warning() for logging
Wait for GameConfig.config_loaded signal or check GameConfig.is_loaded before accessing config values
CameraRig owns mouse mode - do not call Input.set_mouse_mode() elsewhere
Use @export with @export_group for configurable values, not hardcoded constants
Use CPUParticles3D (not GPUParticles3D) for web Compatibility renderer support
